The cylinder-antichain count yields q25=1298518439058409/2^52; the geometric union bound gives 0<=qJ-rho<=2^{-J-1} and the stated arbitrary-m error. A separate compiled C++ enumeration of 2^27 right-tail words independently reproduced the exact J=25 numerator. Positive rho follows from q25-2^-26>0; experiments do not prove the infinite quantifiers, which are supplied by the period and probability arguments.
